verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs show native metadata filtering on vector search, with filter expressions using operators like eq, in and gt, so the core capability is first-party. Nothing in the evidence shows that filtered queries keep recall or latency intact, which is half of what the story asks for; one community comment praises its 'handling of filtering' without detail. Missing for 10: documented or benchmarked recall under selective filters, latency figures for filtered queries, full operator reference, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter vector search by structured metadata conditions without wrecking recall or latency
